preconditions.description: The length of the input string is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in stdin)
preconditions.description: The input string consists of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The number of nonempty parts of the password is between 1 and the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= len(stdin) for xi, li in zip(stdout[1:], stdout[2:]))
postconditions.description: Each start position xi is between 1 and the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(li > 0 for xi, li in zip(stdout[1:], stdout[2:]))
sum(li for xi, li in zip(stdout[1:], stdout[2:])) == len(stdin)
postconditions.description: The sum of the lengths of all parts equals the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: any(li % 2 == 1 for xi, li in zip(stdout[1:], stdout[2:]))
postconditions.description: At least one part has an odd length.
